name: Paul Bellefeuille
biography: Paul was born in Leominster Massachusetts and is one of 6 children. His father Robert and mother Doris Aubuchon Bellefeuille were both born in Leominster but had their family roots in the Province of Quebec. Paul lives in Maine and has 3 children. Paul spent close to 30 years in the broadcasting business as a radio announcer working in NH and MA and was an original member of the New Hampshire Radio Theatre an intrepid group of radio and TV broadcasters who performed a variety of old-time and newly scripted radio shows before live audiences in the late 1990s and early 2000s.
